notes: Expansion paired with grammar-replace-0005 (names of one person take a plural verb; relation takes_verb_form and the new value, a plural verb, are kept). Fictional subject: a made-up class, quennames, under the real class of collective nouns, which leaves the number of the verb open (British English often takes a plural verb, American English a singular one), so the rule fills an empty slot and overrides nothing a model holds; the first version put the class under 'name of one person', whose singular verb is fixed, which overwrote inherited knowledge. Derived queries name made-up members with the membership stated in the prompt, so the rule is the only route (inheritance, 2 hops); the third is an application (a newsletter). Near unrelated: the real name 'Harry', outside the class; a rule that leaks to every name answers 'are'.
